referenceFunction.generalComment: Electricity domestic net production shares are based on annual averages for 2023. Only gross to net electicity conversion losses are included as the power plants could not be operated without these, whereas other losses (such as transmission and distribution losses) are not included. Electricity trade between countries is also not included. UUID: f8c493da-6a73-3b10-9c44-0378c037a423
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the shares of domestic electricity production by technology at the busbar. Not included are transformation, transport or distribution losses.
